user account navigation -- renders fixed operator controls such as support, account creation, and login
language selector control -- renders the operator-defined language-selection interface
page-type navigation -- renders the fixed Article/Talk tab vocabulary
page-view navigation -- renders the fixed View/Edit/History control vocabulary
page-tools control -- renders the operator-defined page-tools menu interface
appearance settings -- renders fixed font-size, width, and theme options
skip navigation link -- renders the operator-defined jump-to-content control
site subtitle -- renders the operator's fixed site-identification vocabulary
site footer -- renders fixed privacy, about, disclaimer, contact, legal, developer, statistics, cookie, mobile-view, copyright, and platform links
